_comment: Held court decisions keyed by the case number they were filed under, normalized by lib/malnummer. Values are [court, decision date, local uri] candidates -- a case number names more than one decision often enough that the citation's own court and date decide. The courts map is what each code calls itself; the phrases a citation uses for them are lib/malnummer's. Generated from the parsed dv artifacts by `lagen dv casenumbers`; do not hand-edit.
